programme.title: Le concours
programme.desc: L'équipe organise un concours sur iCarly.com pour gagner une voiture.

programme.title: Meilleurs ennemis
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie vexent une starlette du web dénommée Fred. Ce dernier tente alors de convaincre ses abonnés vidéo de ne plus jamais regarder iCarly.

programme.title: Trop jeune pour ça
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités à assister à un combat d'arts martiaux pour filmer en coulisses. Mais Spencer et Mrs Benson refusent de les laisser y aller.

programme.title: Que le meilleur chante
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie demandent aux fans d'iCarly de voter pour David Archuleta afin qu'il remporte AMERICA SINGS. Mais ils se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport au deuxième et l'aident à créer son clip.

programme.title: Sam devient gentille
programme.desc: Sam craque sur un garçon qui n'aime que les filles très féminines. Carly aide alors Sam à se relooker.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: La meilleure amie
programme.desc: Missy Robinson, l'ancienne amie de Carly, revient dans sa vie. Sam se sent alors mise de côté.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie perdent l'URL iCarly au profit de Nevel. Ce dernier demande à Carly de l'embrasser en échange de l'URL. De son côté, Spencer s'amuse avec les deux cent oreillers qu'il a commandés par erreur...

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie présentent les iCarly Awards. Ils récompensent en direct les auteurs des meilleurs contenus envoyés sur le site.

programme.title: Mélanie
programme.desc: Surprise, surprise ! Sam a une sœur jumelle appelée Mélanie. Et encore plus surprenant, elle est beaucoup plus féminine que Sam, et craque pour Freddie, qui la prend pour Sam déguisée.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: contre Dingo Channel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent qu'une émission de télé sur Dingo Channel plagie des contenus d'iCarly. Ils décident alors de se rendre à Los Angeles pour confronter les auteurs de l'émission.

programme.title: Laveu
programme.desc: Sous l'influence d'un gaz hilarant chez le dentiste, Sam parle à Carly de son baiser avec Freddie.

programme.title: Le concours de cuisine
programme.desc: Carly et Sam utilisent la recette de taco aux spaghettis de Spencer à l'occasion d'un concours télévisé avec un grand Chef.

programme.title: Yamada, La Voie du Samourai
programme.desc: Yamada Nagamasa est laissé pour mort par les forces japonaises. Il se rétablit dans un village ou il apprend l'art du Muay Boran.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Northmen
programme.desc: Des femmes en quête de vengeance affrontent des Vikings et une armée de démons dans un monastère.

programme.title: Snow White and the 7 Samurai
programme.desc: Laissée pour morte, Blanche-Neige est recueillie par une équipe d'assassins.

programme.title: Mutant Tiger Chronicles
programme.desc: Chine, 560 après J.-C. Un étrange virus infecte des tigres assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: La vengeance du petit chaperon rouge
programme.desc: Le petit chaperon rouge, le loup, et la mère-grand dirigent une agence d'espionnage ultra-moderne. Leur prochaine mission: délivrer Hansel et Gretel qui ont été kidnappés par une sorcière maléfique.

programme.title: Sherlock Gnomes
programme.desc: Les adorables nains de jardin de «Gnoméo et Juliette» sont de retour pour une toute nouvelle aventure à Londres. Quand Gnoméo et Juliette arrivent en ville avec leurs amis et leur famille, leur préoccupation principale est de préparer leur jardin pour le printemps.

programme.title: C.I.Ape
programme.desc: Dans le monde de l'espionnage, certaines missions exigent un agent doté d'un ensemble unique de compétences, possédant non seulement de la bravoure mais aussi la capacité de faire fondre même le cœur le plus méchant. C'est le travail de C.I. Ape ! Le tout premier chimpanzé à rejoindre la C.I.A.

programme.title: Les Lunnis et leurs Aventures Magiques
programme.desc: Marie est une jeune fille pleine d'imagination grâce aux contes racontés par son grand-père. Un jour, le méchant Crude découvre le moyen d'en finir avec le Livre magique qui contient toutes les histoires inventées par l'Humanité et son gardien Lucrecia.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Un malin renard utilise son ingéniosité pour tirer profit de trois fermiers faibles d'esprit qui se résolvent à utiliser des tactiques extrêmes pour protéger leurs poulets...

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: Avril 2012. Une traversée commémorant le centenaire du naufrage du Titanic est organisée. Des centaines de personnes embarquent à bord d'un nouveau paquebot de luxe baptisé SS Titanic II. Au cours de la traversée, un tsunami envoie un iceberg s'écraser sur le navire provoquant le début du naufrage. Un groupe de passager lutte alors pour sa survie...

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Un virus se propage dans un cabinet d'avocats le jour où le jeune Derek est piégé par un collègue et injustement licencié, transformant les collaborateurs en bêtes sanguinaires.

programme.title: The Boy Behind the Door
programme.desc: Enlevés sur le chemin de l'école, Bobby et Kevin se retrouvent prisonniers d'un ravisseur impitoyable. Après une première évasion, Bobby décide de retourner sauver son ami lorsque surgit une menace encore plus dangereuse. Une course contre la montre où chaque décision peut être fatale.

programme.title: 6 heures pour tuer
programme.desc: Chris Montano, ancien Marine, mène une vie paisible avec sa femme et sa fille près de la frontière mexicaine. Quand sa femme disparait soudainement après un voyage d'affaire, Chris se retrouve embarqué dans une course contre la montre pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: Nicolas Shaw fait partie d'une équipe d'élite secrète qui élimine les pires tueurs du monde. Après avoir été accusé de l'assassinat d'un membre de son équipe, il doit laver son nom et empêcher le meurtre des autres agents...

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Traversées
programme.desc: Ca tourne, ça virevolte, ça chute... sur la patinoire. Agile ou grotesque, chacun s'essaie à l'art du patinage. Le film est une ode. Ode à cette vie précaire, ode à cette arène où tant de personnes sont passées pour une heure, une journée, un amour...

programme.title: The Face, The Heel... et Corentin
programme.desc: Corentin est un nouvel élève du catch club de Cognac. Réservé, sincère et persévérant, le jeune homme se donne à fond pour atteindre son objectif : lutter aux Etats-Unis ou à l'étranger. Mais a-t-il l'étoffe d'un catcheur pour y parvenir ?

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood ne veut pas mourir
programme.desc: Dans une demeure isolée, Susan Aylwood, ancienne star du cinéma, vit avec sa gouvernante la discrète Caroline. Entourée de ses souvenirs de gloire, elle mène son entourage à la baguette. Mais quelle terrible vérité se cache derrière les apparences ?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia est entraînée dans un appartement pour une fête. Face à la foule de visages, elle est sans repères, comme perdue dans un paysage de montagne recouvert de nuages.

programme.title: Garage rouge
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon n'ose plus sortir de chez lui après une agression.

programme.title: A perdre haleine
programme.desc: Emile, jeune violoncelliste, est submergé par l'angoisse le jour d'un concert...

programme.title: Léon d'Oural
programme.desc: Au cours d'une prestigieuse course, des chevaux, poussés par les jockeys, enchaînent avec vigueur les obstacles.

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Blanche
programme.desc: Un homme part de la vallée, pour aller chercher des glaciers, des sommets. Il fuit un monde bruyant, polluant. Un monde qui fait fondre les glaciers, qui les réchauffent et les fait disparaître. Il monte, s'éloigne et toujours, pourtant, il sait que le monde d'en bas le poursuit.

programme.title: Papa dans maman
programme.desc: Milieu de la nuit. Des gémissements se font entendre derrière la porte des parents. Deux jeunes soeurs s'interrogent...

programme.title: Le quepa sur la vilni !
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, André sort de sa paisible retraite . Sur ordre du maire, il doit mener à travers monts une troupe d'hommes-sandwichs à vélo pour attirer les spectateurs à l'inauguration du cinéma local.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: Appelez-moi Bruce !
programme.desc: La ressemblance d'un homme coréen avec la légende des arts martiaux Bruce Lee s'avère être une bénédiction mitigée lorsqu'il tombe sur les activités de la mafia.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: Le scientifique à l'origine du projet secret de téléportation et de voyage dans le temps du gouvernement part avec celui-ci dans un avion de ligne lorsque le gouvernement décide de le militariser.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO
programme.desc: À propos des premières années de Yang Luchan, maître de Tai-chi. L'homme qui a fondé le Tai-chi au XIXe siècle et ce qui est aujourd'hui devenu le style de Tai-chi le plus populaire au monde. Le deuxième volet de la trilogie "Tai Chi" poursuit le parcours de Yang Luchan, un enfant prodige qui a aidé à sauver un village des soldats.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: Goldmoon, une société écran qui abrite un syndicat du crime, vient de perdre son président et parrain. La succession est proche, et trois hommes vont livrer bataille pour accéder au trOne. Parmi eux, un flic infiltré depuis 10 ans veut profiter de ce changement pour sortir du syndicat et reprendre une vie normale. Mais comme la police a encore besoin de ses services et que ses concurrents au trOne mènent une enquête sur une potentielle taupe, il va devoir faire un choix: rester dans l'organisation criminelle, ou en sortir.

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Professeur d'économie dans une université du Connecticut, Walter Vale, la soixantaine, a perdu son goût pour l'enseignement et mène désormais une vie routinière. Il tente de combler le vide de son existence en apprenant le piano, mais sans grand succès. Lorsque l'université l'envoie à Manhattan pour assister à une conférence, Walter constate qu'un jeune couple s'est installé dans son appartement : victimes d'une escroquerie immobilière, Tarek, d'origine syrienne, et sa petite amie sénégalaise Zainab n'ont nulle part ailleurs où aller. D'abord un rien réticent, Walter accepte de laisser les deux jeunes gens habiter chez lui. Touché par sa gentillesse, Tarek, musicien doué, insiste pour apprendre au vieux professeur à jouer du tambour africain. Peu à peu, Walter retrouve une certaine joie de vivre et découvre le milieu des clubs de jazz et des passionnés de musique. Et tandis que les deux hommes deviennent amis, les différences d'âge, de culture et de caractère s'estompent. Mais lorsque Tarek, immigré clandestin, est arrêté par la police dans le métro, il est menacé de reconduite à la frontière. Walter n'a alors d'autre choix que de tout mettre en oeuvre pour venir en aide à son ami.

programme.title: Pets To The Rescue
programme.desc: Lorsque un frère et une sœur sont enlevés après avoir trouvé un camion d'or volé, ce sont leurs animaux de compagnie qui doivent prendre les choses en main pour les sauver !

programme.title: The Sherlock Holmes: Valley Of Fear
programme.desc: Un violoniste introverti et fumeur rencontre un médecin et le plonge dans le monde criminel.

programme.title: 6 Below : Miracle On The Mountain
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie, l'aventure de l'athlète Eric LeMarque, qui se perd en snowboard lors d'une puissante tempête. Il a survécu huit jours sans aucune aide, et alors qu'il était en plein sevrage d'une addiction à la drogue.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un mystérieux vagabond accepte un travail de concierge dans un parc d'attractions pour enfants abandonné appelé Willy's Wonderland. Il va vite découvrir qu'il est pris au piège, désigné comme sacrifice humain pour d'étranges créatures.

programme.title: Impitoyable
programme.desc: Un entraîneur de lycée, dont la fille adolescente a été assassinée, prend les choses en main en poursuivant les hommes qui ont kidnappé son élève pour en faire un trafic d'êtres humains.

programme.title: La maison aux esprits
programme.desc: Basé sur le roman à succès d'Isabel Allende, La Maison des esprits est une épopée romantique envoûtante couvrant trois générations de la famille Trueba.

programme.title: La Panthère Rose 2
programme.desc: C'est la panique : plusieurs trésors légendaires ont été dérobés à travers le monde. Afin de découvrir l'identité du voleur, l'inspecteur Clouseau, aussi intrépide que maladroit et gaffeur, est placé à la tête d'une équipe d'experts internationaux.

programme.title: Montana
programme.desc: Une tueuse à gage endurcie et son partenaire gravement malade défendent leur vie après s'être frotté à un baron du crime.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Lorsque Joel et Molly se rencontrent, c'est la haine à première vue : lui et sa grande corporation Candy Company menacent de fermer son magasin de bonbons indépendant et original à elle. De plus, Joel est obsédé par son ex sexy. Mais étonnamment , ils tombent amoureux, jusqu'à ce qu'ils se séparent environ aux deux tiers du chemin, et Molly commence à sortir avec son comptable.

programme.title: Une femme de cran
programme.desc: Alyssa Milano est Patty Montanari, veuve et mère de famille déterminée vivant à Brooklyn. Elle trouve du travail auprès d'une famille de la mafia locale et tombe bientôt amoureuse d'un homme marié et ponte de la mafia (Jason Gedrick de DESPERATE HOUSEWIVES).

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: À la suite de l'ouragan Katrina, l'entraîneur de basket-ball du lycée, Al Collins, rassemble des élèves de cinq écoles différentes de Louisiane et les mène jusqu'aux championnats de l'État.

programme.title: Une vie inachevée
programme.desc: Une femme malchanceuse prête à tout pour subvenir aux besoins de sa fille, emménage chez son beau-père qu'elle connaît mal. Avec le temps, ils apprennent à se pardonner et à guérir d'anciennes blessures.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: Le frère aîné de James, Frankie, sort de dix ans de prison. Il compte bien reprendre les affaires, au grand dam de James, qui est entraîné contre son gré par Frankie dans ce qui est censé être un petit coup avec une bande de malfrats.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Obsédé par la recherche de réponses, un avocat risque sa famille, sa carrière et sa propre vie afin de trouver la vérité sur l'assassinat de JFK.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra, célèbre tueuse à gages, accepte un contrat qu'elle refusera plus tard de remplir en protégeant sa cible et la fille de celui-ci de la terrible et maléfique organisation criminelle appelée « La Main ».

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.2

programme.title: Ne serait-ce que

programme.title: Une Bonne Femme

programme.title: Un hiver à Central Park

programme.title: A Magic Puppy

programme.title: Bernie le Dauphin: Mission Sauvetage
programme.desc: Un frère et une soeur découvrent sur la plage un dauphin brûlé par le soleil et décident de le soigner.

programme.title: Faut S'faire La Malle
programme.desc: Un des films contemporains les plus fous ! STIR CRAZY rassemble deux des comédiens les plus brillants et déjantés d'aujourd'hui : Richard Pryor et Gene Wilder. Skip (Wilder) et Harry (Pryor) ont tous les deux été renvoyés de leur travail. Ils s'embarquent donc vers la Californie pour trouver fortune et célébrité, mais sur le chemin, leur van tombe en panne. Mais ils sont fauchés et il faut bien manger. Ils se font donc embaucher comme piverts chantants et dansants pour faire la publicité de l'ouverture d'une banque. Lorsque deux voyous volent leur déguisement et cambriolent la banque, devinez vers qui on se tourne... Skip et Harry sont donc envoyés en prison pour 125 ans. Ils essaient de rester sains d'esprit et en vie, mais ce n'est pas simple avec un gardien sadique, un meurtrier au physique imposant et un rodéo inter-prisons...

Mais cet incident l'amène à rencontrer Carmine Sabatini, mafieux sosie du Parrain, qui lui confie une mission insolite : transporter un mystérieux colis destiné à une assemblée secrète de gourmets...

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob

These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: The Impossible Football Geography Quiz
programme.desc: A football geography quiz testing knowledge across 6 continents. Contestants must not only know the answer but also locate it on the map. Connacht Ahall joins for the challenge.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

Instead of an elegant affair, the bride wants statues, golden centerpieces and a bridal party outfitted in white robes. David quickly decides to tread lightly with this bride. For him there's a fine line between the Dionysian elegance of the brides' dreams and what could end up looking like a fraternity toga party!

programme.title: Bling Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera knows that every bride wants to be a bright, shining star at her wedding, but when it comes to his new bride Joanne Oleary, he's going to have to come up with a new definition for “Bling!”. When Joanne explains that she's hoping for the ultimate bling wedding: glamour and sparkly fashion at every turn, with her as the diamond in the center, she challenges David to outdo her vision. But as David sees what Joanne has put together, he finds a mismatched mess: shoes on guest tables, sequined fabric for the walls, and flashlights stuck to the walls as makeshift lanterns. Over three weeks, David transforms Joanne's wedding into a nuclear explosion of blinged-out fabulousness! New dresses and jewelry for Joanne's bridesmaids, a sexy and elegant new gown for Joanne, and for a surprise that is sure to knock her socks off, Joanne and her girls get to star in their own professional fashion shoot!

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has a special gift that turns any bride's concept into an unforgettable, dramatic event. And when he meets bride Amber Fleener, who wants the ultimate “Phantom of the Opera” wedding, David knows he's the right man for the job. But instead of romance and drama, David finds that while Amber is hoping for a grand production of Phantom, what's she come up with is more like a high school play. With cheap costume masks and fake flowers that look like Christmas decorations, and a venue that's more suited for a block party, Amber is in dire need of David's help. Before she knows it, David is revising everything, giving her a stunning and dramatic new bridal gown, putting her bridesmaids in romantic, classic dresses, and changing the venue to one suitable for the huge production she's hoping for. David even gives Amber an unforgettable rehearsal dinner with family and friends before the big night!

programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E18
programme.desc: After arranging to meet Samantha to celebrate their six month anniversary, Darrin arrives at his office to meet Margaret Marshall, chairman of the board of a cosmetics firm. Margaret, a stunning woman in her late thirties, successful both with men and in business, insists that Darrin fly to Chicago that night to complete the quarter million dollar campaign he had planned for her company. Fumbling out of the anniversary arrangements with Samantha, Darrin flies to Chicago and meets Margaret, who has become quite interested in him, aboard her yacht. There, Darrin sees a cat and feels it may be Samantha, egged on by her mother, Endora, to fly to Chicago to check on his activities. While Darrin evades Margaret's advances, a pelican arrives on the scene. Although both Margaret and Captain Kelly feel there is something strange in Darrin's reactions to the animals, Margaret, realizing Darrin is truly in love with his wife, ac-cepts his advertising campaign. Greeted by Samantha at home, Darrin is reassured that the cat he has brought with him is not his wife. However, when the pelican arrives, Darrin is uncertain whether it might not be Endora.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E19
programme.desc: After Endora promises to curb her witchery for the even-ing, Samantha arranges a dinner for Darrin's parents and her mother to meet. Darrin is fearful of the results. Father Stephens has just retired and feels lost and insecure. Endora, being utterly charming, as she has promised Samantha, plays up to Father. Father once more feels life is worth living, but Mother Stephens becomes jealous. Before Mother is through, she is sure Endora wants to take Father from her. She asks Darrin for the name of a divorce lawyer. Darrin and Samantha work feverishly to save the marriage. Despite their efforts, Mother takes a train to Arizona and Father boards a plane on the first step of a world trip. Samantha asks Endora's help. Using her witchcraft, Endora brings both plane and train to Angel Falls, where Father had proposed to Mother years before. In the romantic setting, both realize they are much younger than they thought.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E20
programme.desc: When Darrin refuses to allow Samantha to act as matron of honor at cousin's wedding in Egypt, Endora tells him he's in trouble. Immediately Darrin starts having problems with his campaign to get the Woolfe Brothers Department Store account. despite Darrin's protests, Larry Tate gives him an assistant. The assistant, young Gideon Whitsett, soon maneuvers himself into being regarded as a brilliant young man. On the make, Gideon soon has Woolfe looking to him for ideas, which he has stolen from Darrin. Darrin is sure that Gideon is a warlock whom Endora has assigned to take his job. When everything else fails, Samantha decides to stop Gideon herself. Using witchcraft, Samantha gets Gideon to reveal the ruthless maneuvers he has been using to get Darrin's job. Darrin, who overhears the conversation, finally realizes Gideon is not a warlock. A right to the jaw puts Gideon out of action. His confidence restored, Darrin sells Mr. Woolfe on his idea for a successful campaign.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E21
programme.desc: Darrin's agency is unable to find a model for the "Jewel of the East" campaign. Darrin hopes they'll be able to do so, if only to bolster the confidence of Wally Ames, who is sub-stituting for the company's top photographer. Samantha trans-forms the Stephens' cat into a beautiful Oriental girl named Ling Ling. Everyone flips over her and the campaign is wrapped up. Darrin invites Larry and Louise Tate and Wally to a victory celebration at his home. Wally, intrigued by Ling Ling's feline grace, brings her along. Samantha's efforts to make Ling Ling give up Wally fail. To avoid a catastrophe, Samantha is forced to tell Darrin and asks him to warn Wally off, but Wally only becomes angry with Darrin. Samantha spikes Ling Ling's drink with truth serum. Wally bows out when Ling Ling displays her true cat nature. Later, Gladys Kravitz calls her husband when she sees Ling Ling clad in a mink coat, lapping milk from a saucer. By the time Abner gets to the window, Samantha has returned Ling Ling to her original state, and Abner gives his wife a spoonful of her nerve medicine.

programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a sub-continent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness. The 4,000km between the coasts are made up of a patchwork of contrasting landscapes: tropical rainforests, snow-capped mountains, dry woodland, giant wetlands, tropical reefs and hostile desert. These vast tracts of wilderness boast the world's most unique and bizarre wildlife communities. In this ‘hidden' Australia, there is an astonishing surprise at every turn.

programme.title: Hidden Germany

programme.title: Rivers Lifeblood
programme.desc: Rivers flow like veins across the Earth, a lifeline to countless ecosystems. Since the dawn of time they've fuelled the development of animal and human life alike. Habitats in constant flux, they change with the seasons, gradually transforming over time. As we run the river's course, we meet the spectacular animals who depend on it. These waterways are as much as lifeblood to this wildlife as they are to us. They deserve our respect and protection – they're our lifeblood and we must keep them flowing.

programme.title: Endangered with Michaela Strachan

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these car routes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured!

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: AGNI VAYU
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.2
programme.desc: Yeom, the son of the Chief Scholar, is a man of irresistible charm who, after placing first in the state examination, is appointed as the Crown Prince's tutor. Displeased with his young teacher, Hwon engages in a tense battle of wits with Yeom—unaware that he is Yeonwoo's brother.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.3
programme.desc: When Nokyoung encounters Yeonwoo and Bogyeong together, she senses an ominous presence. Queen Dowager Yoon orders that the physiognomy of the young maidens be examined in preparation for selecting a future queen. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa takes Yeonwoo and Bogyeong into her care as court maidens and, upon discovering that Yeonwoo is Yeom's younger sister, begins to openly favor her.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.4
programme.desc: The Yoon Daehyeong faction schemes to place Bogyeong as the future queen of Gyotaejeon. Ahead of the royal selection of the Crown Princess, Hwon secretly expresses his wish for Yeonwoo to submit her maiden registration. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa's feelings for Yeom deepen, and she stubbornly demands that the king grant her permission to marry him.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.5
programme.desc: Yeonwoo remains at the royal villa, Eunwol Pavilion, devoting herself to rigorous court etiquette training. Unable to withstand the Queen Dowager Yoon's threats, Nokyoung casts a forbidden spell on Yeonwoo. Cast out of the palace and sent back to her family, Yeonwoo's illness steadily worsens. In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.6
programme.desc: Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.7
programme.desc: Nokyoung repeatedly warns Yeonwoo to be wary of strangers. Defying Seol's pleas, Yeonwoo ventures into the streets, drawn by her desire to glimpse the king's royal procession. Catching sight of Hwon from afar, Yeonwoo is thrown into deep confusion.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.311
programme.desc: Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy this new extraordinary performance presented by An Ji-Yeong!In this episode, BOL4 performs “FRIEND THE END, ”ROME,“ ”Red Lipstick,“ ”Stars over me,“ and more to show off her artistry. Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter BOL4! BOL4 is An Ji-Yeong's one-person band, known for its adorable sounds and lyrics depicting spring, stars, cherry blossoms, and the universe. In April, BOL4 released its new album, “LOVE.zip,” illustrating various forms of love through the language of music. Following the release, An also held a concert and impressed the audience with her unique, silky voice as well as her growth as a musician. BOL4 is making a comeback on I'm LIVE for the first time in 4 years, marking its third appearance, with the first one in 2017 and the second in 2019.

programme.title: UMEED INDIA
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: TYOHAAR KI THAALI
programme.desc: Sakshi Tanwar in Tyohaar Ki Thaali decides to celebrate one festival a week and along with the celebration, she also prepares two dishes from her mom's diary which is her prized possession. Along with preparing the dishes she also reminisces into the moments of how she celebrated some festivals and also shares some stories about the Gods.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

But her own house, a midtown Toronto duplex, doesn't measure up. As a result, she feels more at home on the road than in her own house. Designer Samantha Pynn uses silks, metallic wallpaper, glass tabletops and mirrored doors to transform Beth's dowdy living quarters into a glamorous and luxurious space.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Off on another adventure! This episode takes Mike Donia on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia as he searches for a home for his clients, Antonio and Kim. Featuring properties in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines, each country has its own unique charms to offer the would-be buyers. Monkeys, mangoes and mansions are in store for Mike as he continues his hunt for that perfect property.

programme.title: Pure Design
programme.desc: Homeowners Frank and Liliana fell in love with their home's 1930s architectural details but quickly realized their contemporary collection of furniture didn't quite fit. Inspired by the look of English Revival, designer Samantha Pynn plays on the classic period features in this living and dining room, while introducing environmentally friendly furniture and modern pieces to bring the look into the 21st century.
